author: Connie Loizos
title: OpenAI's planned data center in Abu Dhabi would be bigger than Monaco - TechCrunch
description: OpenAI's planned data center in Abu Dhabi would be bigger than Monaco, according to a report from Bloomberg.
content_summary: OpenAI's planned data center in Abu Dhabi marks a transformative milestone in the global AI infrastructure landscape. Spanning an immense 10 square miles, this data center's scale surpasses the entire principality of Monaco and will operate with a power consumption equivalent to five nuclear reactors. This project, part of OpenAI's ambitious Stargate initiative developed with Abu Dhabi's G42 conglomerate, aims to bolster AI development capabilities on an unprecedented scale. While the U.S. capacity project in Texas is expected to reach 1.2 gigawatts, Abu Dhabi's facility will more than quadruple this capacity at 5 gigawatts. The collaboration highlights deepening U.S.-UAE AI ties, reinforced by Microsoft's $1.5 billion investment in G42, but not without concerns regarding G42's past ties to Chinese entities and national security. G42's commitment to divest from China aims to address these apprehensions. Ultimately, this data center cements Abu Dhabi's status as a major AI hub, potentially accelerating AI innovations globally.

title: The 145% tariff already did its damage : Planet Money - NPR
description: Even though the 145% tariff on Chinese imports only lasted a month, it already inflicted its scars on the economy. Global trade is just not something you can turn off and on like that. Some companies got really unlucky.
content_summary: The brief yet impactful imposition of a 145% tariff on Chinese imports to the U.S. has demonstrated the fragility and interconnectedness of global trade systems. Although active for only one month, the tariff caused substantial disruption to supply chains and logistics, resulting in severe cost increases for businesses caught mid-shipment. Medium-sized companies importing $1 million in goods experienced an additional $1.45 million in tariff costs alone. The episode sheds light on how global commerce cannot simply be turned on or off instantaneously without lasting economic repercussions. Stories from affected businesses illustrate the wide-ranging and enduring consequences of such abrupt policy shifts, underscoring the sensitivity of international trade to geopolitical tensions.

author: Chance Miller
title: CarPlay Ultra: Features, supported cars, more - 9to5Mac
description: After three years of anticipation, Apple officially launched next-generation CarPlay this week, dubbed CarPlay Ultra. CarPlay Ultra packs countless new...
content_summary: Apple unveiled CarPlay Ultra, its most significant overhaul of the car infotainment system in years, delivering a deeply integrated and customizable driving experience. With complete control over all of a vehicle's driver displays, CarPlay Ultra allows automakers to embed their branding and tailor interfaces uniquely. Aston Martin leads adoption, with several other automakers committed to supporting the platform. Drivers can customize instrument clusters, center displays, and widgets, while native integration enables control of vehicle functions such as climate, tire pressure, and driving modes directly through CarPlay and via Siri voice commands. This innovation represents Apple's strategic advance in blending the iPhone ecosystem with core vehicle operations, enhancing personalization and immersion.

author: KOMO News Staff
title: CVS to acquire & operate 64 Rite Aid stores in the PNW, buy customer prescription files - KOMO
description: CVS Pharmacy has announced its agreement to buy the prescription files of 625 Rite Aid pharmacies across 15 states.
content_summary: CVS Pharmacy's acquisition of 64 Rite Aid stores across Idaho, Oregon, and Washington, along with customer prescription files from 625 Rite Aid locations in 15 states, marks a significant consolidation in the pharmaceutical retail sector. Following Rite Aid's bankruptcy and extensive store closures, this court-approved transaction will expand CVS's presence in key Pacific Northwest markets. While subject to regulatory approval, CVS aims to facilitate a seamless transition for customers and employees, leveraging its extensive network of over 9,000 stores nationwide. This acquisition exemplifies the ongoing industry trend of consolidation amid financial distress in traditional retail pharmacy chains.

author: https://gothamist.com/staff/stephen-nessen, https://gothamist.com/staff/ramsey-khalifeh
title: NJ Transit strike foists riders onto Amtrak, which charges $70 for a 17-minute ride - Gothamist
description: Without NJ Transit rail service, riders were left with fewer commuting options and a whole lot of reasons to complain.
content_summary: The NJ Transit strike has severely disrupted daily commutes for over 100,000 riders, forcing many to resort to costly alternatives like Amtrak, which charges $70 for a mere 17-minute ride. Initiated due to contract disputes with locomotive engineers, the strike halted all NJ Transit rail service, leading to gridlocked roads, lost workdays, and widespread frustration. Governor Phil Murphy's call for remote work underscored the strike's profound economic impact on the region. The dispute highlights vulnerabilities in transit infrastructure and labor relations, with negotiations ongoing and hopes for a swift resolution to restore critical commuter services.
